description: Update one authorization with its ID and access token: units_used (the units or sessions used so far on an approved authorization; the day the next authorization is prepared follows the pace) and/or clinical_document_base64 (a PDF, JPG or PNG up to 3 MB, in a request of at most 4.4 MB; up to 4 MB as multipart form data to PATCH /v1/authorizations/{id}). A document sent while the payer waits on more information goes to the payer next. Returns what changed and the authorization.

access_token.description: The access_token prior_authorization_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

clinical_document_base64.description: A PDF, JPG or PNG up to 3 MB, base64 encoded, in a request of at most 4.4 MB.

units_used.description: Approved authorizations: the units or sessions used so far.

name: prior_authorization_update
title: Send units used or a clinical document for an authorization
